topics.title: Welder Apprenticeship Training Program Orientation
topics.outcome: Upon successful completion, learners will be able to explain how welder apprenticeship training works in Alberta, including curriculum and attendance expectations, contract and portfolio responsibilities, employment sectors, and external organizations affecting the trade.
objectives: Explain the Welder curriculum guide learning outcomes and objectives.
Describe the responsibilities for the contract of apprenticeship and competency portfolio by the apprentice, sponsor and Alberta Apprenticeship and Industry Training.
Identify industrial, commercial and construction fields that provide employment opportunities for welders.

Define the role of external organizations that affect the welding trade. This section establishes entry-level readiness for welding work by covering apprenticeship orientation, OHS safety and regulations, rigging/material handling, and hazardous materials/fire protection, then building hands-on skills in oxyfuel equipment setup and cutting, tool use, arc cutting/gouging, and weld fault identification.

topics.title: Climbing and Material Handling: Lifting, Rigging and Hoisting
topics.outcome: Upon successful completion, learners will be able to apply correct climbing, lifting, rigging, and hoisting practices by following material handling and storage procedures, calculating load weight and centre of gravity, verifying sling and rope capacity limits, and using lifting and rigging equipment.
objectives: Climbing, lifting, rigging and hoisting safety.
Identify procedures for handling and storing materials.
Determine weight and centre of gravity of loads.
Identify the load limits of wire rope and synthetic slings.
Describe the use of plate clamps and cable clips.

topics.title: Hazardous Materials and Fire Protection
topics.outcome: Upon successful completion, learners will be able to safely apply hazardous materials and fire protection practices by using handling, storage, transport, and venting procedures, and by identifying fire hazards/classes and using appropriate fire protection equipment.
objectives: Describe handling, storing and transporting procedures for hazardous material.
Describe venting procedures when working with hazardous materials.
Describe hazards, classes, procedures and equipment related to fire protection.

topics.title: Welding Safety
topics.outcome: Upon successful completion, learners will be able to apply safe work practices during welding and cutting operations to identify hazards, select and use PPE, apply controls for welding fumes and gases, use electrical safety precautions, and follow procedures for work in confined spaces or potentially dangerous enclosures.
objectives: Identify hazards for welding and cutting operations.
Identify the use of personal protective equipment for welding and cutting operations.
Explain the hazards and controls involved with welding fumes and gases.
Explain the effects of electricity and precautions used to prevent injury.
Describe the procedure for welding or cutting in confined spaces or potentially dangerous enclosures.

topics.title: Oxyfuel Equipment and Cutting
topics.outcome: Upon successful completion, learners will be able to assemble, adjust, operate, shut down, and maintain oxyfuel equipment; perform hand-held and machine oxyfuel cuts on mild steel plate, pipe, and structural shapes.
objectives: Identify causes and preventive measures for backfires, flashbacks and burn backs.
Describe how to operate a hand-held oxyfuel cutting torch on mild steel plate and structural shapes.
Describe the characteristics and handling procedures for oxygen and fuel gases.
Describe the functions of oxyfuel equipment components.
Explain the procedure for placement, set-up and shutting down of oxyfuel equipment.
Demonstrate the use, care and maintenance of oxyfuel equipment components.
Describe pressure and flame adjustments.
Perform straight line, bevel, and shape cutting on mild steel.
Pierce and cut holes in mild steel plate.
Cope 3/8 in. mild steel to fit a 100 mm (4 in.) C shape.
Perform cuts on structural shapes.
Operate a machine oxyfuel cutting torch on mild steel plate and pipe.

objectives: Define the classifications of weld faults.
